tei:div.tei:p: 30thakhakha0putha 1/khya0 thakha 3papupukhu/3 7030pa(0000kha 0( na505503 na7 khu3 kha07ོ0(50/ 5 khon00nan ༅3 00bkabaka0kha 3 04720na0

༄༅//dpe skrun gsal bshad/mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar 95ra ma tshor :skuyig sa mtshor95 ra te :skuzur ge mobazhugs pa' bad yag da rnyang pa ta khrar langs pa rang byung dang 'a gnad 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu

me bo'i shulabazhagal / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/'di 'dra'i dpe skrun mnyam las kyi go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob — 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams —2

dpe skrun gsal bshad/myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang /mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhikha 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/ 'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—3—

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen pobaco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis/ sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol btod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs rbe1 cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/—1—

mesapo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/oka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod pa ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu/ /zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ tanangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig /bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams tsa da phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phral yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/ de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis —2

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigasems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/rig gnas gsar brje mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrigadape skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams —3—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/gsos/ 'khrugs pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa sogs rim pa bstar chags su par du skrun dang bskrun rtsis las/ da lan nga tshos klong chen rab 'byams pa'i snying thig ya bzhi dang / mdzod bdun/ngal gso skor gsum/ gsung thor bu bcas pod nyer drug 'tshol bsdu thub pa mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi nang du bsgrigs te/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan zung yangs pa'i 'bab stegs su 'bul rgyu yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhen skyes rnams 'a mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gnas slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/ mes rgyal la 'khas rtage 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/ spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

dbyugyi/ /bsdu sgrig gsal ngakhrind/phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang / khyad par snga 'gyur ring lugs yongs su gsal bar mdzad pa'i/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung chos rnyed tshad phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du skrun pa la/de yang mdzod bdun dang mun sel skor gsum sogs ni bla rung nang bstan slob gling nas gsar skrun ji bzhin sor bzhag yin zhing / de yang mdzod bdun ni a 'dzoms dang / sde dge'i shing par ma/ dpal yul dgon du bzhugs pa'i bris ma dang / gzhan yang sngar 'bras spungs dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa chos dbyings mdzod bris ma dang / theg mchog mdzod gung thang par ma dang / rdzong sar bris rnying sogs phan tshun dpe bsdur zhus pa'i gsal bshad kyang chos tshan so so'i bsdur mchan du bkod yod/ snying thig ya bzhi dang / ngal gso skor gsum sogs ni sde dge'i par ma ma phyi gtso bo la/ mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas mchis pa rnams/ a 'dzoms par mar dag bsdur zhus te mi 'dra ba dag(〈sa〉mi 'dra ba'i yig 'bru)gug rtags 'di'i nang bcug yod/ 'grel mchan yod rigs rnams shing par ji bzhin glog klad du 'khrid stabs ma bde bas dkyus tshig dang phreng gral gcig tu bkod de gzhung yig dang mchan gnyis rtsing zhib so sor phyes shing / dpe deb kyi dum mtshams dag ma phyi las yar bsnan mar dbris cung zad dang bcas pod che chung snyoms thabs byas yod/ dpe —5—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/deb thams cad kyi mgor chos tshan so sor gzigs pa stabs bde yong ba'i ched dkar chag da lta'i dpe deb spyi 'gros ltar bkod pa las gzhung don dngos la ma dpe ltar sor bzhag byas yod/ dus rkyen 'pho 'gyur ci rigs pas 'thor gyar song nas ma phyi re re tsam las ma bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon rigs dang / do dam dpe mang gi mdzod du bskyil ba'i rnyed 'tshol dka' ba rnams kyang gang nus ci lcog gis/ 'gro song dang ngal ba la ma 'dzems par btsal 'tshol bgyis khul du/ rgya che'i chos lugs las rigs mi sna dang / gzhon skyes rig gnas lhur len pa tsho'i bsam blo'i dpal yon dang / zhi bde 'cham mthun sogs mdor na da lta'i spyi tshogs 'dir phan du re ba dang / ma 'ongs mi rabs phyi mar yun du gnas pa'i rkyen grogs su 'gyur na snyam pa'i re 'dun gyis/ rtsis 'phrul gyi par gzhir bcug ste 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po/ blo dkar gzhung drang gi gzur gnas dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi rogs 'degs ci lcog gnang ba thugs rje che zhu/bod ljongs dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/—6

tshu/ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer ni/ lho kha gra nang du yab sngags 'chang bstan pa srung dang / yum 'brom bza' bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga pa'i sa pho sprel lo ste spyi 1308lor sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga tsam nas yi ge 'bri klog bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bdun nas bzung lo 'ga' shas kyi ring yab las phur pa sogs kyi man ngag phyag bzhes dang sman rtsis sogs thun mong gi rig gnas 'ga' byang chub par mdzad/ bcu gnyis par bsam yas su mkhan po bsam 'grub rin chen las rab tu byung ste mtshan tshul khrims blo gros su gsol/ de nas slob dpon bkra rin/ btsan dgon pa/ bla brang pa chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ chos grags gnyis par grags pa gzhon nu rin chen/ blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ shug gseb rin po che/ sa skya'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma khro phu pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gnyis lhag tshul bzhin bsten te/ bod yul du grags pa'i gzhung lugs man ngag bcas pa dang / thun mong shes bya'i rig gnas phal cher gsan cing sgro 'dogs legs par bcad/ lhag par du rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza'i drung nas gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi gdams pa mtha' dag nyams khrid du gsan nas bya bral kun spangs kho nas/ mchims phu la sogs dben —7—

me bo'i shulabazhag la / klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/gnas dag tu zas gos sogs kyis mthun rkyen dman kyang dngul chu'i bcud len dang / sgye mo zhig yod pa des gos gdan gnyis kyi go bcad de bzhugs pa sogs dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes snying por mdzad pas/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha du mas byin gyis brlabs shing / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ gangs ri thod dkar sogs nas skal ldan slob ma mang por zab chos 'doms pa dang / mdzod bdun sogs ma 'ongs gdul bya'i khyad du rtsom pa/ zhwa'i lha khang gis mtshon pa'i rten gsum nyams pa rnams gso ba sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas rgyal bstan yun ring du bskyangs par mdzad/gzhan yang gdul bar dka' ba'i glo mon dge sdig mi shes pa dang /mon bum thang sogs dam pa'i chos kyi sgra mi grags pa rnams su'ang / brtse ba chen pos dge bcu'i lam la bkod cing / mthar dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa chu mo yos 1363lo rgyal zla'i tshes bco brgyad nyin mchims phu ru ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas zhi bar gshegs so/ /zhal slob kyang rgyal sras bzod pa/ bla ma 6rdzo rgyan pa/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bla ma spos gong pa sogs dang / legs par bshad pa'i gzhung lugs kyang mdzod bdun dang / ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum sogs shin tu mang ngo // //zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/—8

dkar chagabi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/ rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/ 27rbestog tshad nges pa'i kha byang sgron ma rang gsal/ 42bstan pa bu gcig gi rgyud gser gyi snying po nyi ma rab tu snang byed/ 48btags pas ༷ la bar bstan pa bu gcig gi gsang 'grel/ 68rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa mchod 'os rang bzhin gyi tshig dus gnad nges pa/ 181sangs rgyas kyi 'das rjes gsum/ 189gser yig can sangs rgyas kyi 'das rjes gsum/ 194rigs 'dzin gyi 'das rjes bzhi zhar byung dang bcas pa 200'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi sgom nyams drug pa/ 203shrī sing ha'i gzer bu bdun pa/ 208mkhas pa bye ma —la'i zhal chems/ 215rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi man ngag rin po che zangs 1

dkar chagayig can/ 222rin po che rlung gi pra khrid/ 271gsang ba yi ge ma ru'i yang tig 281man ngag mdo byang bsdus pa'i sgron ma/ 295dmigs gtad gsal ba'i 11na ma/ 298gsang ba chen po rtags kyi yi ge 302gsang ba chen po tshad kyi yi ge 315mngon sum snying thig gsang ba'i yi ge dmar ru'i snying thig rgyab yig 325zangs yig can gyi snang byed sgron ma/ 334

༄༅/ /bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa bzhugs so/ /tha snyad tshig gis mi mtshon don dam lta/ /byin brlabs brgyud pas stsol lam a ti'i theg/ston mdzad kun bzang yab yum rdo rje sems/ /dgongs brgyud bla ma tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs/ /sgra tshig bya rtsol las 'das chos nyid bden/ /gnas lugs brdas 'jal rtogs grol dus mnyam pa/ /dga' rab shrī sing 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /bi ma mi tras byang chub bar du skyongs/'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yang zhun te/ /rgyud chen bcu bdun snyan nas snyan du stsal/ /lce btsun ldang ma bod byon grub thob kyi/ /snying thig bla brgyud tshogs la dad phyag brtsegs/ khyad par gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi/ /mgron du legs bos mkhan slob chos gsum gyis/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi 'od 'bum brdal bas/ /'khor ba'i gcong mun bsal der snying nas gus/ /lung rtogs skal ldan shing rta'i spun zla gang / /kun nyon rus bu bkru phyir brgyud pa'i tshul/ /lam gsum las 'ongs gang mkhyen dza hrū'i/ /ltor bskyil bka' drin sum ldan bla mar 'dud/ /snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i gser ldan ma/ /stobs 'byor dpung pas khur ba'i lhag ma can/ /sde bzhi dge bcu'i mnga' bdag chosargyal gyi/ /gdung brgyud rgyal po dzaḥde 'di min su/ /chos brgyad dbu rmog btsan pos khengs pa can/ /ltar snang 'jig rten 'byor pa phru ma'i gur/ /bden du —1—

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/'dzin pa'i rgyal phran gel pa phal/ /dge bcu'i mig gis chos rgyal mchog 'dir ltos/ /skye kun legs byas tshogs gnyis sa bon gyis/ /deng 'dir bod chen 'dzin mar dbang bsgyur zhing / /bstan la sri zhu mi lhod ngo mtshar gyi/ /rnam thar 'di kos 'jig rten skal bzang byas/ /de la gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir/ skal bzang sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes grags pa 'di nyid/ rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du bzhugs pa yin yang / re zhig yongs grags la 'dul ba rnam pa bzhis mdzad pa bcu gnyis mthar dbyungs nas mdo lugs chos 'khor rnam pa gsum bskor nas gsang sngags slar 'byung bar lung gis bstan pa ltar/ ri ma la ya'i rtser gsang ba'i bdag pos rigs can lnga la chos 'khor bskor ba'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po dzaḥl rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba dang bcas ma hā yo ga'i rgyud rnams glegs bam gyi char babs/ a nu yo ga'i rgyud rnams siṅga lar bab/ de skabs nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud rnams rdo rje sems dpa' la dngos su gsan/ sngags phyogs rang gi bzhed pa ltar na sngar bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs dus gsang sngags yod par yang 'dod cing / rgya gar du grub pa thob pa du ma gsang sngags spyod cing skal ldan skyong yang sngar gyi lung de yongs su ma grags pa la dgongs/ bod 'dir chos rgyal khri srong gis mkhan slob gdan drangs nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing mdo sngags kyi bstan pa khyab brdal du spel/ khyad par nyang ting 'dzin bzang —2—

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/pos lung bstan pa ltar slob dpon bi ma mi tra spyan drangs pa dang / lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis rdzogs chen gyi chos du ma bsgyur/ chos rgyal yab sras sogs kyis gsan/ slar phyi rabs kyi gdul byar dgongs te dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang du gter du sbas pa ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis bton par bi ma snying thig tu grags pa dang / pad+mas rdzogs pa chen po'i skor te sgro brag dkar du sbas pa gter ston rin chen tshul rdor pas bton pa mkha' 'gro snying thig gnyis la ma gnyis dang / snga ma'i don snying po dril ba bla ma yang tig dang / rjes mar myu gu dang / sdong po dang / lo 'bras me tog sogs bskyed pa bzhin rgyas par bkral ba mkha' 'gro yang tig ste bu gnyis la snying thig ya bzhir grags/ bi ma snying thig ma bu'i don gsal bar kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas bkral ba zab mo yang tig yin pas/ chos 'di rnams nyams su blangs na gsang sngags spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i skus bskal pa ma stongs bar 'gro don mdzad par rgyal dbang pad+ma dang / bi ma la lta bu yin zhing /rgya bod du grub pa thob pa shin tu mang ba'i gtam yongs grags la bskyar zlos ma dgos/skabs don gleng bar 'os pa ni rgya gar du sngags gsar rnying gi dbye ba med kyang / bod 'dir bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyis phye ba yin mod/ de la sngags phyi nang gi nang par rnal 'byor bla med ces theg pa'i ya gyal du 'dod pa mtshungs la rnying ma rnams de las lhag par a nu dang a tir dbye bas theg rim dgu byung zhing / 'dir bshad kyi rdzogs pa chen po ni theg pa'i rgyal po ste 'di nyid kyis —3

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/gzhal na rim pa 'og ma brgyad po'i theg pa rnams kyis don la yod ma myong ba'i sems rtog glo bur ba 'ba' zhig gis 'gyur ba med pa la blos bzo 'chos shing bsgyur/ spang du med pa la gnyen pos bcos nas spangs/ bsal du med pa la bsal 'dod kyi blos skyon du dmigs/ thob tu med pa la gzhan nas thob byar yod pa'i re dogs kyi dbyen bcug /rtsol sgrub dang bral bar 'bad rtsol gyis ma rig pa chen pos rang gnas kyi ye shes la bsgribs pas rnal ma'i de kho na nyid la reg pa'i skabs med pa ste/ 'di ltar theg pa 'og ma'i nyan rang gis rtogs pa'i bdag med ni shes pa dang rdul rdzas la don dam du 'dod la/ rnam rig smra bas rang shes rang gsal nyid kyi rnam shes la don dam yongs grub tu 'dod pa dag ni 'jig rten pa'i sems dang sems byung las 'das pa med cing /dbu mas bden pa gnyis kyis gzhal ba'i skye med/ 'gag med/ yod med/med min la sogs gtan tshigs chen po bzhi la sogs pas dpyad pa'i 'gog bden dang / mtha' bral dang / spros bral sogs kyi mtshungs dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i stong par 'dzin pa dang / sngags 'og ma'i bya bas dag pa gsum gyi lha gtsang sbra sogs dka' thub kyis mnyes pa'i dngos grub 'grub par 'dod pa dang / nye ba'i rnal 'byor gyis lta spyod gong 'og ya cha bas mtshan 'dzin dang /rnal 'byor gyis don dam pa'i byin rlabs lhar bltas nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rnal 'byor la dmigs pa dang / rnal 'byor chen pos bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du gcun pas ye shes skye bar 'dod cing / rjes su rnal 'byor gyis dbyings ye shes bskyed bya skyed byed lha'i dkyil 'khor du blta spro —

bi ma snying thig gi dkar mag nyin mor byed pa/ba sogs mdor na a nu man chad kyi rim pa de dag thams cad blos rig pa'i grub mtha' kho na ste/ de dag thams cad kyang blo ngor 'di ni med do/ /stong ngo /bden no/ /snyam pa'i snyam byed dang / yid byed dang / rtog dpyod kyi yul yul can la chos nyid yin par brlams pa las gnyug ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong ba ni med do/ /de dag rnams ni sems kyis byas shing bcos pas sems ni tshogs brgyad kun tu rtog pa dor bya'i dri ma yin la/ 'di ltar rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ni sems las 'das pa'i sems nyid rig pa rang byung gi ye shes 'od gsal 'dus ma byas par gshis kyi yon tan thams cad lhun grub tu bzhugs pa las bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras dang gzhan gyi rkyen la sogs pa'i khams la rang bzhin gyis grol bas ltos mi dgos pa nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid gnas lugs 'pho 'gyur med par grub pa'i gnad kyis thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po nyid kyang byas pa med par rang byung gi ye shes rang rtogs pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas pa las thos bsam dang 'du byas pa'i tshogs bsags sogs rkyen gzhan gyis ma byung bar bstan pa ste rtsa ba shes rab las/ rang bzhin rgyu dang rkyen las ni/ /'byung bar rigs pa ma yin no/ khyu dang rkyen las byung ba ni/ /rang bzhin byas pa can zhes byar/ /ji lta bur na rung bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag ni bcos med dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /ces gsungs pa 'dis rang bzhin gshis kyi gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i grub pa'i mtha' rgyu rkyen las 'das pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes mngon par rtogs pa'i sgra —5—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/dbyangs mngon sum du sgrogs par mdzad do/ /de la a ti ni shin tu ba'i don te/mchog dang / rab dang / phul dang / rtse mo dang / yang snying du gyur pa'o/ /yo ga rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor thams cad kyi mthar thug pas na shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /de nyid rdzogs rim thams cad kyi snying por gyur pas de'i bla na bgrod bya gzhan med la/ 'di nyid kyis shin tu zab cing brtag par dka' ba'i nam mkha' lta bu'i skye ba med pa'i chos nyid bcar phog tu ston pas na chen po'i sgras bstan pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nam mkha' ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos ston pa ni shin tu chen po'o/ /zhes bka' stsal pa'ang 'di'i nges tshig la dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar yin na de'i phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin 'di nyid bde bar gshegs pas bka' 'khor lo bar par spros pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs rgyas par bstan mod kyi/ gshis kyi bzhugs tshul ma bstan/ 'khor lo tha mar gshis kyi bzhugs tshul bstan kyang de mngon du byed pa'i lam mtshan nyid pa ma bstan/ de'i phyir 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs pa 'phags mchog klus bkral ba'i rigs tshogs kyi dgongs pa ma 'gyur ba dang / de'i chos dbyings bstod pa sogs dang / tha ma'i dgongs pa rgyal tshab byams pa dang 'phags mchog thogs med sku mched sogs kyis bkral ba bcas shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa mthar thug 'gal bar mi 'du bar rdzogs pa chen po nyid du don gyis gnas te gang gi phyir zhe na/ rang bzhin chos nyid zab mo'i gnas lugs de las gzhan slob dpon de dag mi bzhed cing / de las gzhan du rdzogs pa chen po'ang ma grub —6

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na gsum ste/ sems kyi sde'i ngo bo ni theg pa'i rim pa dang /bden pa gnyis dang / phar phyin drug dang / rim pa gnyis sogs la der 'dzin gyi 'du shes dam pos dkris pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i lam bden 'du byas pa gang zhig dag mnyam chen po'i ye shes gnyug ma'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba don dam bden pa'i gshis de nyid rgyu 'bras dge sdig blang dor gyi cha las rnam par grol ba'i dbyings chen por la bzla ba'o/ /de ltar bstan pa zab mo'i gnas la blta ba'i blo gros kyi spyan phra ba 'ga' zhig gis rdzogs chen gyis thabs kyi cha yal bar dor ba/ las rgyu 'bras la skur pa btab bo/ /zhes nan gyis 'gog par byas so/ /zab mo'i gnas la byis pa'i blo gros skrag pa skye ba bden kyang chos 'di pas rnam shes rtog pa'i yul las 'das pa'i ye shes kyi rgyal khams don dam pa'i bden pa chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas su smra ba gang zhig khams gsum dang dkar nag las kyi cha 'du byas pa'i khams su mi gnas shing de las yongs su grol ba'i bdag nyid can du 'dod pa'i phyir rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa sngar gyi lung rnams kyis kyang rtogs par nus la/ gal te der 'dod na/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rtsa shes las/ las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las/ /de dag spros las spros pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes/ las dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras thams cad rnam rtog gi mtshan ma tsam las byung bar gsungs nas de dag thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyis zhi bar gsungs shing / de nye bar zhi ba'i tshul yang / gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang / /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros —7—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/pa/ /de ni de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ nyon mongs las dang lus rnams dang / /byed pa po dang 'bras bu dag /dri za'i grong dang smig rgyu dang / /mig skusnar chu zla ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / de nyid kyi dbu ma srid pa 'pho ba las/ cir yang mi rtog stong pa ste/ /yid la mi byed skye 'chi med/ /snang ba sgyu ma dge sdig bral/ /stong dang snying rje 'khor 'das stong / /sgyu ma gsal stong brjod med kyi/ /chos nyid gsal dngos rtog pa med/ /ces sogs don dam bden pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i don 'dus byas pa'i dkar nag gi las thams cad kyis 'ching grol med par bzang ngan ro mnyam chen por rtogs par sngar smos pa ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin smon pa med pa'i mtshan nyid can du la bzla ba'i chos nyid drang thad du ston pa'i skabs te/ sems sde la dbye na bdun te/ 'bras bu sems kyi byung sar 'dod sems phyogs pa/ gol sgrib la bzla ba/ gtan tshig khung rdib pa/ rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa/ phyogs 'dzin grub mtha'i sa/ blo bral phyogs 'dzin las 'das pa/ sems kyi phyogs yin du smra ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa klong gi sde'i ngo bo ni rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid kun tu bzang po'i klong yangs par chos can ji ltar snang ba thams cad rang snang bkod pa'i rgyan tsam las 'ching 11la dang / shar bya shar byed du ma grub pas/ sems sde ltar rtsal dang rol par snang bar mi bzhed cing / ltos grub dang / yod med dang / yin min dang / dag ma dag gang du'ang mi dpyod par ye grol phyogs 'byams chen por gtan la phab pa 'di nyid kyi grub pa'i mtha'o/ /dbye na klong —8

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/nag po rgyu med du smra ba/ klong khra bo sna tshogs du smra ba/ klong dkar po sems su smra ba/ klong rab 'byams rgyu 'bras la bzla'o/ /de dag kyang bsdu na/ rol pa/rgyan/ chos nyid/ bya bral gyi klong bzhi'o/ /man ngag sde ni/ 'og ma gnyis las khyad par du gyur pa ste/ 'di ltar sems sdes sems yin pas gsal ba las zab mo'i phyogs shas che bar bsgrubs kyang / gsal ba'i rtsal chos nyid du ma rtogs pas yid dpyod du 'dzin par nye zhing / klong sdes zab gsal mnyam par bsgrubs kyang chos nyid la 'dzin pa'i yid dpyod las stong phyogs kyi gol sar shor nye la/ man ngag sde ni/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa brjod bral blo 'das chen po'i gdangs rang snang lhun grub kyi rang rtsal las chos can gyi snang ba thams cad chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su sdud pa'i don gyis khyad par du 'phags pace(/ /ngo bo ni/ gdod ma nyid nas grol zhing ka nas dag pa'i chos nyid la nyi tshe ba'i blta bya'i yul dang / lta byed kyi shes pa gnyis su chad pas 'khrul ma 'khrul dang / rtogs ma rtogs su bsgrub pa'i ltos gzhi dang / ltos pa'i chos las log pas/ rang gi ngo bo spros bral gyi cha nas shes bya shes byed kyi yul yul can gnyis ka yang dag pa ma yin par mnyam zhing tha snyad tsam du btags pa las der 'dzin gyi bsam brjod las yang dag par 'das pas na/ blo dang / yin snyam dang / snyam byed dang / yid dpyod las 'das pa'i don gnad thog tu phebs pa'i me btsa' lta bu ste/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ thams cad yang dag yang dag min/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin nyid/ /yang dag min min yang dag —9—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/min/ /de ni sangs rgyas rjes bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'jam dpal gyis/ rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /med nas chos rnams mtshan nyid spangs/ /chos dang chos nyid yang med do/ /dngos po med pa'i mkha' dang mtshungs/ /tshig dang yi ge kun las grol/ /zhes so/ /'di la nang gses kyi dbye ba mang du yod kyang mdor bsdu na/ lus dang 'dra ba phyi skor/ mig dang 'dra ba nang skor/ snying dang 'dra ba gsang skor/thams cad rdzogs pa dang 'dra ba yang gsang snga na med pa'i skor te bzhi'o/ /dang po phyi skor gyi ngo bo la nyon mongs ma grub pas dug lnga lam du khyer/ rang bzhin la rtsol sgrub med pas cir snang chos nyid du shar/ mtshan nyid la phyogs cha med pas stong nyid gang du'ang phye ba med pa'o/ /nang skor gyi ngo pogazugs can las 'das pas mtshan ma med pa'i chos nyid/ rang bzhin 'gro 'ong med pas rtag pa rgyun gnas kyi ye shes so/ /mtshan nyid ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka la zug pas rtsa ba lta bu/ rang ngo tha dad du 'gril bas sdong po/ rtsal snang cir yang rgyas pas yal ga /gsal cha mi 'gag pas me |rtog /sna cenags gcig tu smin pas 'bras bu lta bu'o/ /gsang skor gyi ngo bo ngo sprad pa dang rtogs pa dus mnyam pas shes rab gsum la ma ltos/ rang bzhin dbugs chad pa dang grol ba dus mnyam pas goms stobs la ma ltos mtshan nyid ni sangs rgyas pa dang thugs rje 'byung ba dus mnyam pas rgyu tshogs gnyis la mi ltos pa'o/ /yang gsang bla na med pa ni/ngo bo shes bya ma yin pas shes byed la mi ltos rang bzhin mngon sum mthong bas —10

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/chos nyid yid dpyod du mi gnas/ mtshan nyid ni snang ba bzhis 'bras bu phyis dus la re ba mi 'cha' bar tshe 'di nyid kyis gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su sbyor ba'o/ /de ltar bstan pa thams cad kyi snying po rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag sde pa'i lugs 'dis so so'i rang gi rig pa ni ye shes kyi nyams su myong bya'i yul yin la zag pa dang bcas pa'i nye bar len pa'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad po'i rang bzhin can gyi sems las 'das pa'i tshul ni/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/sems dang ye shes bag chags dngos ma yin/ /ye shes bag chags kun dang bral gyur kyang / /sems kyis sna tshogs bag chags sdud par byas/ /sems dang ye shes gnyis su ma phye na/ /snang ba yul gyi rtsa ba mi chod pas/ /rkyen bral chos nyid dag kyang rtogs par dka'/ /zhes dang / nā ro pa'i kho na nyid sgrub pa'i thabs las kyang / byang chub sems kyi rang rig 'di/ /bag chags zhabrul pa'i dbang gis na/ /brtags pas sna tshogs med bachin 'grub/ /sems kyi bag chags phyir snang yang / /rig pa 'od gsal 'gyur ba med/ /ces dang / rnam rtog sems kyi rgyu ba bral/ /rang rig 'od gsal 'dzin pa med/ /ces so/ /mdor na snang grags bsam yul du gnas so cog thams cad ni sems kyi snang ba ste 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyi rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i sems te/'phags pa rnye1nga phrag brgya pa las kyang / sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes 'jig rten pa'i sems sems byung las 'das pa'i sems nyid kyi don du gsungs pa'ang snga ma dang don gcig go /gzhan yang 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sems dang yid dang —11—

me po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/rnam par shes pa dang yang bral ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas kyang mi 'dor ba ste/'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / sems med pa na chos kyang med/ /de ltar lus dang khams kyang med/ /de ltar gnyis med lam gyis ni/ /de nyid du ni rab tu bshad/ /ces pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyang sems las 'das pa'i rigs la dgongs pa yin te grol lugs chen po bzhi'i ngang du gnas pa rang gi rig pa rang byung gi ye shes de gnyis lam 'di nyid kyi khyad chos su nges par byas nas/ de tshul bzhin rtogs par bya ba la stong ngos ka dag gis rig pa spros bral du gyur pas stong pa'i chos zad sar byed pa khregs chod dang / snang ngos lhun grub kyis rdos bcas 'od gsal du dwangs pas snang ba'i chos nyid zad par byed pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni theg pa mchog 'di'i dgongs pa rig pa'i ngo bo 'ching grol med pa'i gshis lugs ka nas dag pa'i ngo bo de nyid ma bcos pa rgya gang du'ang ma chad/ rang gi rang bzhin la ngo bo 'di zhes gdags su med pas phyogs gang du'ang ma lhungs shing / rtog pa'i blo dang bral bas bsam brjod las 'das pa'i zang thal rjen pa'i rig pa de nyid stong pa nyid dang / lam dus tshig dang yi ges mi mtshoni pas mtshan ma med pa dang /'bras bu'i ngos nas thob bya re dogs med pas smon pa med pa dang / rig pa'i cha las byang chub kyi yon tan rnams rdzogs shing 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin gyi rnam par thar pa bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi rig pa gang la lta sgom spyod 'bras rtogs bcas rtogs med kyi shes pas bsdus pa'i chos rnams mi 'grub cing —12

bi ma snying thig gi dkar mag nyin mor byed pa/bltas pas mi mthong / bsgoms pas mi rtogs/ spyod pas phan mi btags/'bras bu sgrub tu med la/ de med pas sa la sbyang ba dang / lam la bsgrod pa dang / 'bras bu la dmigs pa dang / de dang de'i rim pa'ang byar med pa ste/lam 'dis sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthar thug pa chos kyi sku yin na de ni thob la gzhan du/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yi/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi sku/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de'i phyir rdo rje snying po ka dag gi rig pa ni gdod ma'i chos kyi sku'i yin lugs ji lta ba la goms su 'jug pa ste/ spros pa'i sgrib byed las grol ba nyi ma rang bzhin gyis gsal ba lta bu yin la/ rim pa brgyad po'i nyer len sems kyi kun tu rtog pa 'ba' zhig gis bskyed pa'i mtshan bcas kyi rim pa la brten pa sgrib byed kyis sgrib pa sbyangs nas gzod nyi ma mthong bar 'dod pa lta bu'i khyad yod pas rang byung gi ye shes la rtog pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyis ma bcos par rang bzhag nyid du la zlo ba ste rig pa de nyid rgya yan/ ma bcos/ mi 'chos/ mi bsgom/ mi yengs/ mi zhabrul/ rtog dpyod ma zhugs pa/ lhag gi rjen ne/ lhod de bar rang bab tu bzhag pa tsam lta ba dang sgom pa'i ja dwags btags pa tsam ste/ rang shar las/ rig pa spros dang bral ba la/ /'khrul dang ma rig ga la skusnad/ /ye shes sems dang bral ba la/ /ma rig bag chags ga la yod/ /ces so/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis rig pa ka dag chen po'i gshis ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs bcar phog tu ngo 'phrod pa la gzung 'dzin gyis 'ching mi nus shing / de la bsgom bya sgom byed —13—

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/kyi slad mi gzhug pa'i tshul rdo rje'i gad mo chen po bcu gnyis sogs kyis legs par ston cing / lam 'di nyid la goms pa brtan par gyur pa na mthar gyis grol ba'i ka dag chen por sdud pa ni 'byung bzhi rags pa'i rdul phran ye shes kyi me stobs su gyur pas sbyangs te/ cho 'phrul chen po dang bcas te thim par 'gyur la gzhan don du 'gyur na rdul phran dengs pa de ring bsrel rnam bzhir sprul nas 'jog pa'ang yod la/ rig pa ni chos sku'i dbyings su 'khyil nas sprul pa'i sku rgyun chad med pas 'gro don mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa lhun grub kyi snang ba gtan la phab pa thod rgal gyi man ngag ni/ de yang khregs chod kyi gzung yul 'khrul pa'i snang ba gzhi med rtsa bral gshis thog tu grol ba yin la/ 'dir ni khams gsum gyi snang cha de dag thams cad rig pa'i rang gdangs 'od lnga'i thig le chen po'i 'od gsal du grol ba'i phyir 'og ma las khyad par du 'phags par bshad pa 'dis kyang dbyings kyi snang ba dang /snying po rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud smin pa'i mthar chos nyid zad pa'i snang bas khams gsum phyi nang gi 'byung ba rnams 'od gsal du dengs pa'i lam mdor bstan cing / de yang bca' ba lus kyi gnad gsum/ 'khrid pa dbyings kyi gnad gsum/ snang ba yul gyi gnad gsum du bsdus te/ lhag mthong gi rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud la bltas pas goms pa'i rim pas snang ba gzhir 'byongs shing / chos nyid mngon sum gyis zhing khams kyi sgo phye/ de las thig le sku ru smin du nye ba nyams gong 'phel sprul sku/ sku ru smin pa rig pa tshad phebs longs sku/ de nas snang ba thams cad thig le chen po gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dag —14—

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/nas blos btags pa'i chos so cog thams cad zad cing chos nyid du 'dzin pa tsam yang zad pas chos sku'i snang ba mthong ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba yis/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel ba yis/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba nub pa dang / /bar de'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /rig pa tshad phebs snang ba yis/ /sku gsum rtogs pa'i lam snang 'dis/ /chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba yis/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyun thag chad/ /ces so/ /'di ltar gsang ba bla na med pa 'dir thog ma nas 'khor ba'i sems las 'das pa'i rang byung gi rig pa nyid bcar phog tu lam du byed pa la mkhas pas myur du 'bras bu rang thog tu phebs pa'i gnad kyang de yin la/ de ltar ma yin na nyams su len dus 'khor ba'i sems dang sems byung las 'bras bu 'khor ba nyid de rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar gcig pa'i phyir 'gal bar 'du ba'i skabs med la/ khyad par mngon sum 'od gsal la lta ba'i rig pa skad cig ma de nyid ni khams gsum pa'i sems sems byung kun gzhi dang bcas pa ldog pa ste/mngon sum la bltas pas nang kun rtog gis 'phro 'du med pas 'dod pa'i sems log /gsal pa'i ngang las gsal bar 'jog byed kyi gnyen po med pas gzugs kyi khams las log /rtog med rtse gcig la chos nyid kyi ngang du zhen pa'i blo med pas gzugs med kyi khams las log /dwangs la rig pa'i phyir kun gzhi las log /rang byung gi ye shes su thag chod pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes las log /snang ba 'od gsal gyi yul las tha mal gyi rjes su snang ba med —15

me po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(te/pas sgo lnga'i rnam shes las log /de'i tshe dpyod byed kyi rtog pa dang chags sdang gi kun rtog med pas yid shes dang nyon shes las log ste/ mdor na khams gsum gyi sems dang sems byung thams cad las rnam par grol ba ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhi ba nyid las gzhan ma yin pa'i mthar thug pa ste/ gang dag sngags kyi grub mtha' rgyud sde 'og ma rnams su ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar tshud pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su 'dod pa gang zhig /tshogs brgyad kyi rnam shes las ma log ste/ tshor ba bde ba ni yid dang nyon yid kyi rjes su bskyed cing / sems rtog med kyi cha ni kun gzhi las gzhan du ma 'das shing / rlung dang khams rnams ro rkyang gi lam nas dbu mar 'jug cing / de'i rtsa mdud re re grol stobasakyis sa bcu'i spangs rtogs 'char bar 'dod pas 'gro drug gi rtsa 'dab tu rlung sems zhugs pas ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang 'char ba'i phyir gol ma gol kyi gnad kyang de yin la/ 'dir ni rlung rnams rang zhir 'jog pa las dbu mar 'jug pa sogs med cing rtsa 'dab so so'i rlung rang dag la song dus 'od kyi rtsa'i ye shes kyi rang sa na rang gsal bas dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba sku dang / zhing khams dang 'od kyi rang bzhin las ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang 'char ba'i skabs med cing dbu ma'i 'od kyi rtsa rnams 'phel bas/rtsa mdud kyi rnam pa rnams rim gyis 'od du yal ba'i yon tan las sa'i mngon rtogs rnams rang snang du 'char ro/ /de yang rtsa mdud dang po gnyis 'od du yal bas/ phyir snang 'od kyi nang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams brgya phrag 'char la/ de dag tu 'od zer 'gyed pa —16—

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/dang / rang snang du 'dus pas bgrod pa dang / lus 'gul bas zhing brgya g.yo ba dang / nang du chos nyid mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya la 'jug cing ldang ba la sogs 'byung ba'i phyir de dag gis mtshon pa'i lam 'og ma las ches khyad par du 'phags par shes par bya dgos la/ de ltar snang bzhi'i lam mthar phyin pa de'i tshe khregs chod kyis lus rdul phran du dengs pa yod kyang rdo rje'i sku mi 'grub/de ma grub pas rten des 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar gzhan don rlabs po che sgrub pa'i thabs med pas/ gzugs sku de nyid chu'i zla ba ltar snang gzugs skusnad kyang reg gzugs med par bzhugs nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med par mdzad pa la 'pho ba chen po'i sku zhes slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /bi ma la mi tra lta bu'o/ /gal te rten des re zhig gdul bar bya ba med na/ phyir gsal zung 'jug gzugs kyi sku'i rang snang de nyid nang dbyings spros pa dang bral ba chos sku'i ngang du thim nas so so rang gi rig pa phra ba'i ye shes nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i tshul gyis 'khyil pa las/ de'i ngang du gdul byar 'dul byed kyi rol pa bkye ba na/ 'gag pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ye shes 'phro ba'i gzhir shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa las ma g.yos bzhin du bzhugs pa'i chos nyid de ni dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku'i mthar thug pa ste/ ka dag dang lhun grub gnyis med kyi grol sa ka dag chen po gdod ma'i gzhi'i gnas lugs su byang chub pa yin la/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma rnams kyis 'di skabs su 'jug pa thams cad zhi ba'i 'gog pa dam pa la gnas pas rang —17—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/sang gi sku dang ye shes kyang mi 'dod de spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nyid kyang stong pa mtha' gcig tu bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs ni lta ba yongs grub/ rgyu 'bras dag mnyam/ bden pa dbyer med/ gzung 'dzin rang zhig /skye 'gag zang thal/spros ma spros kyi mthar ma lhungs/ blos ma bcos/ phyir mi 'phro/ nang du mi gzung / bar du mi bzhag /brjod tshad thams cad tshig dang tha snyad kyi sbun pa/bsam tshad dpyod tshad thams cad rtog pas btags pa kho nar song bas rang ngo khas len gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i ngang du la bzla ba zhig ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ rig pa'i chos thams cad bdag rtog gi blo dang bral bar shes par gyis shig /ces so/ /'on kyang snga phyi ci rigs pa rnams su chos nyid zab mo blos byas kyi sgrub par rlom pa rnams ni chos nyid blo bral gyi gtam zab mos skrag par 'gyur zhing / 'dis lam gyi rim pa 'og ma rnams sun phyung ba ltar snang ba la zab mo'i phyogs dang rgya che ba'i gnas la shin tu mdza' ba ma yin pa'i rtog ge'i blo gros ltar snang dang lhan cig tu dus snga phyi tsam la'ang phrag dog pa'i dka' thub res 'ga' ma yin par lhur len pa dag byung mod kyi/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ bya ba rnams la rnal 'byor pa/ /lam chen dag tu yongs 'dzin pa/ /ri dwags smig rgyu snyegs pa ltar/ /rtag tu snang yang mi zin no/ /de bas de dag thams cad kyang / /yang dag min pa'i blo dang bcas/ /'og ma 'og ma'i rnal 'byor blo/ /gong ma gong ma'i khyad par 'phags/ /'og ma'i blo ni gong ma yi/ /shes rab kyis ni sun 'byin no/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin shes —18—

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/par bya zhing rtsod pa'i kun slong chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du zhi ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /skabs 'di'i snying thig ya bzhi ni man ngag sde'i yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor yin par shes par bya zhing / spyir rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid 'di snga 'gyur rnying mar phug thug kyang / gsar ma'i mkhas grub khyad par 'phags pa du mas kyang nyams bzhes mdzad pa phyogs tsam brjod na/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis kyang thugs nyams su bzhes tshul so so'i gsung du gsal la/ de bzhin du rgyal ba'i dbang po garma pa rim byon dang /rje btsun tsong kha pa/ kun mkhyen lnga pa rin po che sogs kyis kyang thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad tshul so so'i rnam thar dang gsung sogs gung bstun pas shes shing / sa lugs la bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti zhes pa'i rdzogs chen gyi chos skor zab cing rgya che bar yod la/ dkar brgyud phyogs la chos rje rang byung rdo rje la bi ma la mi tras dngos su gnang ba'i rdzogs chen garma snying tig zhes pa'i skor dang / sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgyu 'phrul zhang g.yu brag pa 'a17 ba'i mgon pos kyang rdzogs chen gyis chos tshul rang gter du bzhes pa'i lo rgyus snang la/ rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'i sku g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan phreng bas stsal ba g.yu thog snying tig dang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med tsong kha ba chen po'i thugs dam du/ grub chen las kyi rdo rjes dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog ces rdzogs pa chen po'i lta grub kyi zab gnad ji —19—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/bzhin du ston pa'i chos skor rgyas par yod la/ de dag gis mtshon pa'i snyan brgyud dang dag snang du byon pa'i chos tshan sogs grub mtha' so sor nang gses phran tsheg mang yang thams cad smos kyis mi longs so/ /de bas na rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sde thams cad kyi yang zhun snying thig ya bzhi zab mo yang thig bcas bsod nams dpal gyi 'du byed po chos rgyal mchog 'di'i rigs brgyud ni/ 'od gsal lha yi gdung brgyud rngu chen rgyal mo tsha bco brgyad kyi ya gyal 'gar chen ye shes bzang po'i sras gnyis las bsod nams rin chen gyis 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyas 'phags pa'i zhabs la thug ste gsol dpon gyi las ka bzung / se chen rgyal pos 'ja' sa sogs chen po'i las ka byin/ sku tshe'i mthar sa dmar yang dgon du tshogs pa stong phrag tsam chos kyis bskyangs/ de'i dbon po rngu rgu ru la sras dgu 'khrungs pa'i nang nas stong dpon zla ba bzang po la gong ma mchod yon gyis sa dmar stong dpon gyi go sa gnang / de'i sras rngu rgyal ba bzang po'i sras pad+ma bstan srung / de'i sras dkar chen byang chub 'bum/ de'i sras rngu chos kyi rdo rje ni gaḥthog rdo rje gdan du byon te mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan bsten nas gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin par mdzad nas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ mched ya bde chen bsod nams bzang po yum 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs sgrub par daḥ thog tu byon nas phyir ma phebs par/dge 'dun rgyal mtshan sogs mched gzhan rnams kyis phyir 'bod par mdzad pa na/ garma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang / rngog chos kyi rdo rje gnyis nas lung —20

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/bstan pa ltar phyir ma phebs par rim gyis lcags rar gling sa skyong bdag drung gi gam du phebs nas las shugs kyi mnga' thang chen po bdo ba'i 'go tshugs shing sde dge zhes pa'i mtshan yang 'di skabs shed du byung bar mngon/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i bo thar du grags pa des grub thob thang stong rgyal po bla mar bsten nas chos kyi sde 'di nyid thog mar tshugs/ de nas rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong ba rim par byon pa'i sras sa skyong sa dbang bzang po'i rgar rje dpon mo tshe dbang lha mo bsus par sras mi yi dbang po chos rgyal bla ma tshe dbang rdo rje rig 'dzin dang sras mo rta mgrin phrin las dbang mo lcam dral da lta phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par bzhugs bzhin pa 'di yum sras kyis rgyal bstan rin po che thugs dbus su bcangs shing khyad par zab chos 'di bzhengs pa'i phan yon che bar dgongs nas snying thig ya bzhi rin po che dad pas gser zhun mas tshar gcig spus legs na bza' glegs shing dril chas dang bcas te bzhengs 'phror/bla ma yang tig /mkha' 'gro yang thig ste bu pod gnyis par du bzhengs par mdzad pa'i bzang po legs byas kyi 'phro mthud du chos rgyal bla ma mchog gi rgyal srid skyong ba'i sras che ba dam tshig rde rje mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo rnam par rgyas pa'i zhal snga nas gang gi thugs rab zla med pas snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che la gus shing yab rje chos rgyal yum sras rnams kyi mdzad pa 'phro mthud du mkha' 'gro snying thig ste snying thig ma gnyis dang / zab mo yang tig bcas legs byas kyi gtong ba chen po'i phyag ring por brkyangs pas 'byor pa mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes nas bri brkos zhus sbyor so sor ji ltar 'os —21—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/pa'i yon sngon gyi srol rgyun ltar gyis tshim par mdzad nas/ drug cu skor bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan rnam 'gyur lcags stag lo nas rim par bsgrubs te/ rnam rgyal zhes pa chu sbrul lo'i ston gsum lo tog dang 'bras bu yongs su smin pa'i dus bzang por legs par grub pa yin la/ de yang 'chad nyan sgom gsum gang la'ang yi ge la mi brten pa'i thabs med cing / de nyid kyang dag ma dag la shin tu ltos dgos par mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pas legs par gzigs nas chos spyin rlabs po che'i rgyun spel ba'i tshe kho bo la zhus dag byed dgos tshul gyi bka' stsal gtsug gi cod pan du gus pas mchod nas yi ge phyi mo dag pa 'ga' zhig sgo bstun nas dag par byas pa las/ slar yang sdebs nor bcos bslad lta bu'i rigs/ rang blos gang dpog dpyad pas dag par bgyis shing / brda rnying re zung snang ba dang sngags legs sbyar kho nar ma nges pas 'ga' zhig brda sprod pa'i lugs dang bstun par dka' bar snang yang legs sbyar dang bstun zhing mi mthun pa rnams yig rnying sor bzhag las 'ol tshod ma spobs pas dpyad 'os ma mchis shing / gzhan bab bcol med par dpyad gzhir 'os pa rnams btang snyoms su ma song bar yang yang zhu dag grub pa yin/ de yang theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod cing mos pa ni skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag te/dpal mgon 'phags pa klus/ bsod nams chung ngus chos 'di la/ /the tshom tsam zhig za mi srid/ /the tshom tsam zhig zos pas kyang / /srid pa hrul por byed bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs shing mdzad pa bzang po 'dis kyang lha sras nyid byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid gsal bar bstan pa ni/ ji skad du/ du ba —22

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ / rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes pas byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid gsal bar byas pa yin zhing / de yang las bzo ba rnams kyang za yon sogs mi 'phangs par mdzad de las byas don yod mdzad pa bi ma snying thig grags nga 'i chos tshan 'dir dpe cha bzhugs byang la/ thog mar dkar chag nyin mor byed pa sdeb/ 14 ka kha byang sdeb/ 12 kha btags grol rgyud/ 12 ga btags gro pa rgyud 'grel/ 63 nga mchod 'os dus gnad nges pa/ 5 ca sangs rgyas 'das rjes gsum pa/ 3 cha 'das rjes rgyud 'grel dang rig 'dzin 'das rjes zhar byung bcas/ 14 ja bye ma la'i zhal chems/ 5nya spros gcod dum bu bcu drug29 ta rlung gi pra khrid/ 6 tha man ngag sbas dum/8 da mdo byang bsdus sgron/ 2 na dmigs gtad gsal sgron/ 3 pa gsang chen rtags yig 8 pha tshad kyi yi gi 6 ba dmar ru'i rgyab yig 5 ma rgyab yig smad cha/ 14 tsa sgron ma dgu skor/ 25 tsha dpe tho la rang bzhin gnad dbab/dza rlung gi pra khrid zer ba dpe tho la snang ste dpe mi snang / wa yang snying bcud dum/5 zha 'phrul dum/ 4 za sgron ma snang byed/ 34 'a gnad yig gsang ba/ 12ya rgyud khong snying thig sdeb/ 5 ra g.yu yig po ti smug chung / 54 la kha byang ming rnam bkod/ 3 sha dum bu bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa/ 14 sa khregs chod yi ge/ 5 ha sems kyi dmigs drug rnam bshad/ 63 a spros med dbang gi ti dzi 7 ki dbang bskur 'jug pa'i dus bshad/ 4 ku spros med dbang ru shan dbye ba'i pra khrid/ 3 ke spros med dbang gi phra tig ko rab tu spros med dbang / 4 khi —23—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/dbang gi phra tig rnam dbye dpe ma tshang ba rko rgyu ma byas slar dpe rnyed na rko 'dod/khu dbang bzhi ston pa'i dus gnad/ 7 zhe spros med dbang chog 9 kho dam tshig rab dbye/ 11 gi snying thig 31 rgyus/ 24 gu gnas 'byed bdun pa/ 32 ge sangs rgyas 'das rjes gsum gyi rgyud/ 6 go rgya mtsho ar gtad/ 3 ngi ar gtad snang ba 'dus pa'i gal mdo/ 3 ngu bdud rtsi snying thig 4 nge rig pa'i gnad don lta ba/ 2 ngo thod rgal bogs 'don snying gi yang zhun/ 6 ci smug nag khros ma/ 3 cu zab pa pod bzhi/ 2 ce man ngag brgyad bcu dgu'i them byang / 2 co spros bcas dbang gi phyag bzhes/ 6 chi spros med dbang bskur/ 3chu spros med dbang bskur gnad kyi yi ge che bum yig dang dag pa sbyar ba/ 2cho shin tu spros med dbang / ya ji spros med dbang gi ti 1 9 rdu spros bcas dbang lce btsun gyis mdzad pa dang / rdzogs chen dbang gsum pa/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med/ dbang bzhi'i dus mtshan bstan pa'i phra ṭig bcas/24 je nyams len lag khrid ngo mtshar can/ 20 jo bcud phur rgyab yig gsang ba'i man ngag 3 nyi rgyab yig gnad bsdus sgron me/ 2 nyu bsam gtan mig gi sgron me/ 3 nye rten 'brel bsdus pa'i sgron ma dang / nya rdor sems dmigs drug rtsa ba gnyis dpe med/ ti lce btsun nyams mgur/ 1 ā spros med dbang dkyil bri thabs/ 1 bcas chos tshan drug cu re bzhi bzhugs pa yin no/ /chos kyi glegs bam 'di lta bu bzhengs shing gzhan dag la chos sbyin gyi tshul du spel ba bsod nams rgya chen po'i rgyu yin te/ chos spyod bcu'i mdo las/—24—

bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa/yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa dang / /chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag med thob/ /zhes dang / dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod mod kyang / /mthar phyin par ni 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes so/ /'dir smras pa/ /rgyal bas gdul byar 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor gsum/ /drang dang 'dres ma nges pa'i chos 'khor zhes/ /phye bar lung bstan shing rta chen po de'i/ /bzhed srol ldem dgongs bral ba nges don gyi/ /mthar thug lam bden kun gyi bsgrubs 'bras su/ /sa skya paṇa chen bzhed pa'i rdzogs chen la/ /sde gsum skor bzhir phye ba'i yang gsang 'di/ /spyod rnams gdos bcas phung po zad sar 'byol/ /phyi bltas yid dpyod grub mthar mi re ba'i/ /nang du mnyam par 'jog pas gnas lugs don/ / mngon sum dbang po'i yul du blta ba yi/ /ltad mor longs sku'i zhing khams nyul 'di mtshar/ /des na deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo pas/ /mdo sngags chos tshul phal cher ming tsam du/ /lus pa'i dus 'dir yang gsang rdzogs pa che/ /nyams su blangs na byin rlabs cher thob 'gyur/ /'dir 'bad bsod nams rgya mtsho bsrubs skyes kyi/ /dge tshogs nam mkha'i nor bu gzi 'bar bas/ /lnga bde'i mun rum stug po bsal byas nas/ /rdzogs ldan bskal pas 'gro kun 'tsho bar shog /rgyal dang de sras 'gro phyir sprul pa'i gar/ /ris bral bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /chos kyi char 'bebs lung rtogs zhing sa rgyas/ /sku dang ye shes gser snye g.yur za —25—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/shog /bod chen phan bde'i 'byung gnas chos kyi rgyal/ /sa skyong yab sras zhabs pad rdo rje ltar/ /bskal brgyar brtan zhing chos srid dbyar gyi chu/ /'phel rgyas mnga' 'bangs skye dgu skyong gyur cig /bkra shis kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog gsum gyi/ /bden pa bslu ba med pas 'dir smon pa'i/ /don kun bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam shing / /gter gyi bum pa bzang po'i rjes 'gror shog /bi ma snying thig gi dkar chag nyin mor byed pa zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos lha sras rin po che'i bzhed pa bzhin rang gnas zhe chen ri khrod bde chen pad+ma 'od gling du bcad rgya'i skabs bris pa'i yi ge pa ni mchog sprul tshangs dbyangs snyan grags kyis bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o// //—26

༄༅//rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi man ngag zab pa po ti bzhi'i kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa bzhugs so:bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo:'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed pa'i 'od ldan pa'o:sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde chen thugs la mnga'o:gnyis med rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes can no:gzhan gyi rnam par rtog pa'i zhen pa gcod la mkhas:snang ba gnyis po dag ni zad par mdzad la mkhas:skye med snying po rang rig dngos la spyod:brgyud pa gsum gyi rtsa ba nyid 'chang ba: dam pa dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sku gsum la:gnyis med dad pa brtan pos sems g.yos te:lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas:gsang ba'i yang bcud rnams ni gsal bya'i phyir:mos gus skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du:thugs rje chen po mchog la gsol btab nas:yang gsang sbas ba'i man ngag snying thig ma:kha byang rnam pa brgyad du ma bkod pa'i:yang gab sbas pa gsang ba snying gi nor:lhag chad 'gyur ba med pa'i don ched du:gsang ba mchog gi yi ge 'di dag ni:ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du:tshig don gsal bar 'di nyid 'bri bar bya: gsang ba gsang mchog bla na med pa'i ste:snying po yang nges gsang ba'i man ngag rnams:ras chod gzu lum nyid dang bral bya'i phyir:'gyur med don gyi yi ge 'di ltar 'bri:e ma:gsang mchog dam pa gzhan du ma bstan pa'o:27

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (te/snying las lhag pa'i man ngag snying thig la: kha byang rnams su bkod par ma phod pa'i rtsa rnams mdud pa snying la 'dus pa ltar: brgya dang bcu dgu man ngag dam pa rnams: yang gsang snying dang 'dra ba bzhi la 'dus: de kun mtshan tsam brjod par mi phod pa'i: bdag gi khong snying phyungs ba 'di lta ste: don gnyis rdzogs par 'dod pa'i skal ldan gyis: gsang ba dung yig can la goms par bya: de yi mtshan tsam brjod pa bla ma dang : bde gshegs mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol: skal ldam snying gi bu la dgos srid na: 'di nyid tshig tu brjod pa ma gtogs pa: su yis thos na mkha' 'gro'i chad pa phob: de bas snying po sems la rgyas thob la: snying po byang chub bar du khar mi dbyung : gzhan gyis thos shing mthong na rang srog 'tshig: de bas rlung phyogs tsam du bsgrag pa min: 'byung ba'i sgra dang bral ba'i gnas su bskyal: skabs su blta zhid bsnyen bkur chen po bya: rang gis goms par byas la gter du sba: gzhan du bstan zhing gzhan la ma yin no:yang gsang snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag la: bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i bu gcig po: sus kyang byas pa med pa'i yi ge nyid: rang byung kun gyi thog mar byung bas na: skad dang brda rnams mi mthun med pa'i phyir: skal ldan rnams kyis mthong zhing bltas pa'i tshe: yi ge rang rang mthun pa nyid du shes: de yi dbang gis 'byung ba'i sgra dang bral: sa yis bsub cing chu yis khyer ba dang :rlung gis 'thor ba med cing mes bsreg bral: skyes bu rnams kyis bshigs shing mthong ba med: 'di ni bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i gnad: skal ldan snying —28—

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/gi bu yis 'di bris te: bstan pa gang la bab pa'i kha dog ni: rin chen snying po dag gis bris nas ni: rang gi lus dang 'bral ba med par bcang : lta zhid klog pa'i tshe na gzhan dag gisaḥ 'di nyid mthong bar gyur na dngos grub yal:de phyir dur khrod dam ni nags kyi klong : sus kyang rgyu bar dka' ba'i gnas su ni: chu gling la sogs dben par bklag cing mchod: 'di nyid su la snang ba'i mi de ni: skal dang ldan pa nges par grol ba 'o: de ltar nges pa'i man ngag snying gi nor: rab tu zab la med thabs med pa yi: bdud rtsi'i thig pa 'gro rnams nad sel pa'i: snying thig man ngag nges pa 'di dag gsang : su la'ang mi bstan rang gi sems la brnags: snying po'i don rnams lta zhing spyod pa las:rlung dang ser bu'i sgra tsam phyogs su spang : gzhan rnams 'di dang skal pa med pa'i mis: mthong bar gyur yang dam tshig chad par 'gyur: thos par gyur na lus ngag me yis bsreg: de bas rang gi sems la rgyas btab ste rkun po'i nor ltar gsang zhing spyad par bya: su la'ang bsgrags pa med pa'i gsang ba 'di: skal ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: 3ni:mchog tu gsang ba'i man ngag snying nor 'di: mtshan tsam brjod par bdag gis mi phod ste: bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol btab nas: snyigs ma'i dus su 'di nyid dgos srid pas: snying thig zab pa'i kha byang 'di nyid 'bri: gsang chen snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag nyid: yang dag rdzogs pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen gyis: sngon chad thugs kyi klong nas ma rdol ba'i: 'khor ba'i chos nyid gtan nas spang ba'i phyir: 'da' ba med las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i:—29

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/ston pa mya ngan 'das pa'i rjes zhabs la: nam mkha' mi phyed bar snang nyid las kyang : byin brlabs thog mar rang byung yi ge nyid: sprul pa'i gdung ba bcad pa 'di nyid kyang : rin chen lnga yi rgyan dang bcas pa dang : 'das rjes gsum po man ngag snying gi nor su la snang ba de ni mngon rdzogs 'gyur: gang la snang bar gyur pa'i skal ldan des: rang gi zag bcas phung po ma zhig bar:rang nyid snying la bcangs te su la yang : bstan zhing bsgrags na rang srog 'tshig par 'gyur: de bas rang gi sems la rgyas thob cig: gal te phung po 'dor ba'i dus byung na: skal ldan snying gi bu la gtad par bya: 'di yi gong du gcig la bstan srid kyang : dmyal khams me yis rang gi lus sems bsreg:de bas 'chi khar skal ldan zhig la byin: gnyis dang gsum las mang na chad pa phog: rin chen yi ge dag ni bris te 'chang : 'di ltar bgyis na byin rlabs chu rgyun ltar: rnal 'byor dam pa de la gnang ba 'o: gal te bstan pa'i bdag po ma rnyed na: phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbos: 'di ltar 'das rjes gsum po'i don la reg: gsang ba'i yang bcud snying gi gdams pa 'o: gsang ba mchog de rdzogs pa yongs rdzogs che: de yi man ngag snying gi bcud phyungs pa:gzhan du bstan pa med pa'i snying thig ma: 'di yi mtshan tsam brjod par mi phod ste: snying gi yang bcud 'di nyid gsal bya'i phyir: dbang po'i dwangs ma mig dang khong gi snying : phyi ru phyungs te skal ldan don ched du yi dam dam pa 'di nyid 'bri bar bya: gsang ba snying gi gzer bu rig pa'i gnad: lus dang ngag la brten nas mngon sum du: thob mthong 'phel ba'i rig pa 'di dag nyid:—30

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/dbang po'i yul dang 'brel bar bstan pa'i phyir: snying tig yang bcud gsang ba kun gyi mchog: gsang ba'i yi ge ma ru snying gi nor: sngon chad phyungs pa med pa'i man ngag nyid: theg pa mtha' dag rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i: snying gi dkyil du mda' yis phog pa ltar: phyir mi ldog par byed pa'i thabs chen ni: mtshan nas brjod par bla ma brgyud pa dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzod: 'di dang 'phrad pa'i skal ldan nges lung can: zag bcas phung po 'byung ba rang zad la: 'gro bar 'gyur ba the tshom som nyi med gal te snying po gsang ba'i don 'di dang : phrad de nyams su ma blangs don g.yel na: ma spyad bzhag pa'i gter 'dra yon tan med: de yi phyir na snying po'i don 'di nyid : nyams su longs shig skal ldan snying gi bu: snying po'i yang bcud gang dang mi 'dra ba'i:gsang chen nges pa'i snyingapo 'di dag ni: gzhan gyis thos par gyur na dngos grub brlag: mthong bas rnal 'byor rnams kyi 'bras bu yal: mtshan tsam nyid kyang brjod par bya ba min: 'byung ba'i dgras mi tshugs pa'i gnas nyid du:brag gi them pa nyid dam dben par ni: lcags sam zangs sam dngul gyi snod du bstsal: rab tu sbas te sus kyang mthong med par: bzhugs su gsol te skabs su lta ba'i tshe: mkha' 'gro rnams la tshogs gtor byin nas ni: blta zhing spyad par bya ba 'di nyid las: gzhan du rang dgar spyod cing lta ba min: de yi phyir na thabs 'di mchog tu gsang : e ma 'di ltar ngo mtshar che ba yi: man ngag nges pa snying gi nor mchog 'di: 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi:sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di don gsungs pa dang : gsung ba dang ni gsung bar —31—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/'gyur ba min: de yi phyir yang thabs 'di mchog tu gsung : rang gi rig pa mngon sum ston pa yi: yang gsang dril ba snying po rnams kyi bcud: 'di dang phrad pa'i skal ldan nges lung can: sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bar the tshom med:gal te nges pa'i snying po 'di nyid dang : phrad de don 'di nyams su ma blangs na:bskal pa bye ba brgya stong dung phyur du'ang : sangs rgyas 'bras bu nyid ni thob pa min: de bas 'khrul ba'i bya ba kun spangs te: dur khrod dam ni nags tshal chen po'i klong : sus kyang rgyu ba med pa'i gnas mchog nyid: rab tu dben zhing dpag tshad mang po yi: grangs tshad 'das pa rnams kyi pha rol tu: lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnad gcun la: su dang 'phrad pa med par gcig por 'dug:rang gi de nyid 'bral ba med par lta: de ltar gnas pas snying po'i don dang phrad: yang dag pa la snang ba 'di la 'gyur: de ltar rab tu gnas pa'i stobs med na: lung stong ri rtse la sogs nyid du yang : rtag tu ngag bcad lkugs pa lta bur rgyu: g.yin gyi mthong na ri dwags bzhin du bros: 'di ltar byed pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu: yang dag dam tshig dam pa de la yod: rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po zhes bya'o:man ngag snying po 'di ni nges pa'i thabs: yang snying dril ba su la bstan pa med: des na gsang chen dam pa mchog gi thabs: rab tu gsang ste rang gi yid la brnogs: tshig zur tsam dang mtshan yang brjod pa min: mthong bar gyur na nges pa'i 'bras bu yal: sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde chen dam pa 'o:shes rab kyis min dbang po'i yul can no: tshig gis 'di don rtogs pa ma —32

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying this/ gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/yin te: lce yis brjod cing rna bar thos pa med: brjod med don de rnal 'byor ngag gi gnas: lag tu blang ba'i man ngag tshig gsum mo 'di ltar yin no sems kyi bu gcig po gzhan gyis 'di don gsal bar ston pa med: tshig gsum gyis ni sku gsum snang ba ston: 'di don gsang ba yin no sa mā ya: kha byang rnams su bkod pa med pa yi: rab tu gsang ba'i man ngag rnam bzhi nyid:kun la gsang ngo rang gi snying la phur: gzhan la brjod pa med do phyi rabs bu:bdag gis man ngag mang la longs spyad kyang : man ngag 'di don ston mi ma mthong ngo : des na snying gi snying mchog dam par zungs: man ngag rnam pa bzhi yi khong gi snying : yi ge ma ru gsang ba zangs yig can: 'dra min gnyis las snying gi nor mchog 'di: khyad 'phags bstan pa kun gyi khong gzer yin: gsang ba snying gi man ngag bzhi med par: yi ge mang po dkar chab spungs pa 'dra: don med snying po'i don la reg pa med: de kun thad ga'i bden pa ston pa min:snying thig gsang ba zangs yig can med na: lhag ma gsum yang don med yugs sa rkyang : des na 'deg par 'dril ba 'di rang nyid: rnal 'byor dam tshig rab dang 'di phrad nas: 'di don rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu 'grub par shog: a+thi+-i:shes bya rang tshad phebs la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul gzhan gang gis: rtogs par 'gyur ba yang ni ma yin te: de don dbang po'i yul dang 'bral med par: mthong zhing dngos po rtsa ba lta bu ni: gnad kyi yi ge dam pa 'di bzhi la: dum bu nges pa'i grangs ni du yod pa: ma bu nges pa —33—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(2)nyid ni 'di lta ste:bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i bu gcig po:dum bu gcig ste ma bu gnyis yod do:sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'das rjes rnam gsum la:dum bu gsum ste ma bu gsum yod do:gsang ba rgyud kyi khog snying man ngag nyid dung yig can la dum gcig ma bu bdun:yang gsang zab mo gsang ba snying thig ma:yang gab zangs kyi yi ge can la ni:spros bcas rnams la dum bu bcu drug yod:spros med rnams la dum bu gcig gis ston:bu brgyad ma dang dgu yis don gnyis 'grub:de ltar rab zab man ngag rnam bzhi la:dum bu ma bu'i rtog pa bcad pa'i phyir:gsang ba'i kha byang dems zhes bya ba 'o:3|:rang sems nges pa'i dpal phyag 'tshal 'o1:rtsa rnams mdud pa rnam bzhi nyid dang ni:skye gnas nyid dang snying dang mgrin pa dang :tshangs pa'i bu ga dag la mdud pa ltar:gsang chen rgyud dang man ngag bsam yas kyang :snying po don gyi man ngag bzhi la 'dus:de yi man ngag rtsis su byas pa ni:dum bu'i ming dang ma bu'i ming nyid dang :rim pa gsal bar phye ste 'di ltar 'bri:kun la bstan pa med pa'i man ngag bzhi:rnal 'byor kun gyi snying gi nor yin pas:rang gi sems la zhe dga'i yid kyis 'grogs:de dag rnams kyi ma dang bu yi mtshan:tshig tu brjod par bdag gis mi phod kyang :bla ma nyid dang mkha' 'gro'i rigs nyid la:bzod par gsol te phyi rabs don nyid du:dum bu nges pa'i grangs 'di sems la brnogs 'das rjes rnam pa gsum gyi dum bu ni:dga' ldan rnams kyi 'das rjes dang po ni:man ngag rnams kyi rtsa ba dang por bstan:gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nyid babs pa dang po nyid kyi 'grel 34

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/pa'i tshul du bstan:gsum pa bya rgod phung po'i rir babs pa:gnyis pa dag gi ṭi ga'i tshul du bstan:de ltar dum bu gsum gyis 'das rjes rdzogs:de bas mang na snying po'i don nyid bslad:nyung bar gyur na man ngag kha mi skong :de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces:rang gi snying las lhag pa'i zangs yig ma:'di yi mtshan tsam brjod par 'phangs na yang :de nyid dum bu nges pa 'di lta ste:gang zhig spros la dga' ba'i gang zag gis:dum bu'i ming des 'di dag nges par zungs:spros pa gcod pa'i sgron mas 'byung ba'i bslab thabs bstan:goms pa gnad kyi man ngag drug gis mtshon pa'i gzhi ma bstan:sems nyid sbyong par byed pa thabs kyi man ngag gis:dman pa rnams kyi 'jug pa'i rim pa bstan:des na ris chad rjes su bzung ba'i man ngag gces:sbas pa mig 'byed kyis ni lta sgom spyod pa bstan:spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron mes spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bstan:sgom pa bsdus pa'i sgron mas mig gi sgom pa bstan:lta ba bsdus pa'i sgron mas phyi nang lta ba bstan:'bras bu bsdus pa nyid kyis 'bras bu'i thob tshul bstan:nyams len gcud thag nyid kyis sngon 'gro'i man ngag bstan:bcos pa lus kyi gnad kyis rig pa yul la bstan:rgan mo mdzub tshugs kyis ni rig pa'i lta lugs bstan:rig pa spang zin gyis ni rig pa'i 'char lugs bstan:rig pa'i rgyab brten bcud rnams bsdus pa'i snying pos yid ches gtan la phab:'gal ba bsdus pa'i rjesan mas 'gal nyams gtan la phab:gzhan 'dod bsdus pa'i gcud phur gyis ni gzhan lta'i 'dod pa dgag:rig pa bsdus pa'i sgron mas rig pa gtan la phab:sku gsum bsdus 35

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(te/pa'i sgron mas sku gsum rang la sbyar: lta sgom bsdus pa'i sgron mas rnam gsum rig par sbyar: nyag cig bsdus pa'i sgron mas chos sku'i thig le nyag cig bstan: dge sdig bsdus pa'i sgron mas 'khor 'das la yang bzla: de ltar nyer gcig dum bus gsang ba zangs yig rdzogs: shes rab zab mo'i blo yis yang brtags na: dum bu bzhi cu rtsa gcig dag tu nges: spros med rnams ni snying thig nyams len dngos: 'di yis rnal 'byor rnams kyi don chen 'grub: de las mang na gsang ba zangs yig 'chal: nyung bar gyur na snying po'i don mi rnyed: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: gsang ba'i man ngag dung yig can nyid la: shes rab zhib mo'i blo yis yang brtag na: dum bu bco brgyad rgyud kyi mtshan gyis shes: 'di las mang na gsang ba'i man ngag bslad: nyung bar gyur na don gyi snying po nyams: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: ñtsā:rang gi cha rkyen rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo: nges pa'i snying po rang bzhin don gyi bcud : rnam bzhi gzhan du grags pa med pa'i chos: snying thig srang la phab pa 'di dag la: gsal byed snying po bu yi ming nyid ni: nges par tshig tsam brjod par mi phod kyang : bla ma yi dam rnams la gsol btab nas: gnad kyi man ngag 'di dag gsal bya'i phyir: skal ldan sems kyi bu yi don nyid du: gsang ba'i snying po 'di dag tshig tu bkod: snying po nges pa'i rang snang 'di lta bu: ya mtshan mchog tu che ba'i gsang ba nyid: gnad kyi snying po 'di kun yid la brnogs: rdo rje 'chang gi tshig gnad nges pa med na mchod pa'i dus mi shes: de ltar ma dang bu gnyis bsdebs pas bstan pa bu gcig 'grub: de yi phyir na —36—

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/gsang ba'i kha byang gces: gsang ba zangs yig med na gdams pa gnad mi khrol: rigs 'dzin zhal chems med na 'jug sgo gsal ba min: de ltar bu gnyis ma dang gsum gyis 'das rjes gsum pa 'grub: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: chags pa'i pra khrid med na chags can lam mi tshud: rlung gi pra khrid med na nyams len dus mi shes: yang gab sbas dum med na zab pa'i gnad mi shes: mdo byang bsdus pa'i sgron ma med na dmigs pa'i rab mi phyed:dmigs gtad gsal ba'i sgron ma med na lhag chad ngo mi shes: gsang ba rtags yig med na yid ches gding dang bral: tshad kyi yi ge med na dus kyi tshad mi zin: gsang ba rgyab yig med na don med yugs sa rkyang : de ltar bu brgyad ma dang dgu yis gsang ba zangs yig 'grub: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: pra khrid ma gtogs dung yig can yang 'dra: snying thig zab mo don gyi man ngag la: ma dang bu ste dum bu'i rtog pa can: 'di ltar don la yid ches gsal byas pas: phyi rabs 'jug pa'i skal ldan sems kyi bu: the tshom yid gnyis blo dang bral nas ni: snying po'i don rnams bde blag nyid du yang : ma nor 'khrul pa med pa'i sems kyis rtogs: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang 'di: 'jug sgo gsal ba'i don du bdag gis byas: yang dag snying po bde ba chen po ste: rang snang chen po sgro 'dogs kun dang bral: kun gyis mthong ba med pa'i ye shes te: sprul sku bsgrub ste gzhan gyi don byed phyir: 'byung ba rnams kyi sgra la goms byed pa: 'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das: 'gro ba kun la yang dag gnas: de nyid sngon 'gro'i spyod pa gsum: lus sems —37—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (te/gnad la 'bebs pa ni: thabs kyis gar thabs spyod pa yis: ā li kā li rab tu bstan: ji ltar bsam pa bsam gtan nyid: de rjes sor 'jug cho ga ni: mi g.yo ba ni sku yi rgya: mi brjod pa ni ye shes te: mi len pa ni bdag med cing : des na lus ngag yid kyi gnad: de la bskyod pa med bzhin du: rna dbang gzhan la thos mi 'gyur: de bzhin lce yi dbang pos kyang : brjod par bya ba rdul tsam med: gcig ste rnam pa yongs kyi med: de nas rig pa'i yul bstan pa: rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bya lam gnas: de nas rig pa nyid bstan pa: de la de bstan de yang thob: de nyid thabs kyi khyad par ni: zla ba las byung rten dang bcas: rig pa mngon par snang ba ni: mngon sum bde ba rang las 'byung :de nyid rig pa'i ngo bo ni: bzung bas mi zin chu zla 'dra: de nyid snang ba gong 'phel bas: de la phyogs kyi 'od 'dus pas: ngo mtshar rmad byung rol pa ni:rig pa tshad la phebs pa ste: bya ba med pa'i las rnams te: chos rnams zad pa'i sar phyin pa: zab r+sāg na/zab pa'i cha shasasogs yul med zer mo'i cha zhes rtog yul med: tha tshig ming du btags pa med: sgro btags chose kun ga la yod: de ltar lung chen rnams kyis mtshon nas ni: rig pa'i ye shes mngon sum gtan la phab: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag dang : 'gal ba med cing dbang po'i gnad dang bstun: gzhan gyi man ngag tshad phebs rgyab yig dang :rang gi snang ba gtan la dbab pa'i gzer: nges par gtan la phab pa 'di nyid do: rnal 'byor rnams kyi gsang chen dam pa 'o: sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa nyag gcig dang : rig pa nyid kyi ye shes zang ka ma: yul la gcer mthong —38—

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/nyid du ston pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas sprul pa dga' rab rdo rje yis: snying gi srang la phab pa'i man ngag nyid: yi ge ma ru gsang ba snying thig ma: gzhan du bstan re mkha' 'gro rnam gsum dpang : de yi phyir na gsang ba man ngag snying : rang sems stong pa nyid la rgyas btab la: skal ldan sems kyi bu dang ma 'phrad bar: chu srin pir gyi gre ba bzhin du bsdam: gal te bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus byung na: rang gi yid la rang gis rgyas btab la: khong du sbrul zhugs lus la me shor yang : ji srid gnas pa'i bar du khar mi dbyung : de nas bstan pa kun gyi btsas su sbos: dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa yis: skabs su mchod cing skabs su bltas pa yis: mchog dang thun mong gnyis la ci dgar rol: rig pa mngon sum lta ba'i me long nyid: zangs kyi yi ge rnal 'byor kun gyis snying : skal ldan sems kyi bu dang 'di phrad nas: lus ngag yid la bar chod mi 'byung bar: rig pa'i ye shes tshad la phebs par shog: yang gsang dril ba man ngag kun gyi snying : sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen snying po'i don:theg pa thun mong rnams las khyad 'phags pa'i: dbang bo'i yul dang 'brel ba'i gnad mchog 'di: lus kyi gnas la brten nas mngon sum bar: stong pa'i yul la 'gyur med srang du tshud: 'bral ba med cing rang gi don dam nyid:rtog pa ma yin mthong yul rnam par dag: 'di ltar ngag gi gnad la brten pas ni: brjod du med pa'i rang gnad yul la mthong : de yi phyir na gtan tshigs 'u/nga gi gnad: mi ga༄/nga mnyam par bzhag pa sngags tshig yin: sems kyi gnad la brten pa yis: me long nang du bzhin ltar bstan: rig pa'i ngo bo —39—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (te/mngon du mthong : de yi phyir na nges pa'i bka': mngon sum pa dang rgyab nas 'byung : spyir na gsang sngags 'bras bu nyid: mngon sum pa dang phyi nas yin:'di ni rgyab thob ma yin par: mngon sum nyid du byed pas na: 'bras bu nyid las lam du byed: gzhan gyi tshig gis ma yin par: rang gi mthu yis rig pa 'o: 'di dag tshig tu bkod pa yis: rig pa'i don la yid ches pa: mi 'gyur brtan pa'i don du 'o: rin chen snying po lta bu'i debs: snying du gdams te gsang ba'i don: phyi rabs bskal ldan nges lung can: 'jug sgo gsal bar bya ba'i phyir: yi ge dam pa brjod pa'i brda: bla ma'i man ngag thugs kyis bcud: rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal med par: sems kyi bu yi don du bsdebs: 'di la 'khrul pa yongs med kyang : gal te 'khrul pa byung srid na:rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang : bla ma nyid dang mkha' 'gro la: bzod par gsol zhig sa ma yā: de yi phyir na 'khrul med dngos: gsang ba'i gnad dang bstun nas ni: mtshan yang brjod par ma phod pa'i: snying thig gsang ba'i chos bzhi yi: tshig la 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir: dbang po mig dang don gyis snying :lus kyi rtsa gnad ji bzhin du: chos rnams kun gyi gnad bkrol nas: zab mo rnams kyi yang zab pa: snying po yang nas yang bsdus pa: thig le nyag cig mdor bsdus nas: dgos don gsal ba 'di nyid du: bstan nas tshegs chung don che ba'i: snying po nyid la 'gyur med pa'i: rin chen gsang ba'i kha byang 'di:skal ldan yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir: snying thig man ngag 'khrulamed par:nyams blang tshad du phyin par shog: gsang chen nges pa'i snying po la: rang dbang —40

rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi kha byang nyi mas brgyan pa/nyid du thob pa dang : sku gsum ye shes lnga rnams kyi: snang ba lam du rdzogs par shog: mthar thug chen po'i tshad phebs dang : chos rnams zad pa'i sar skyol rbe|ga: kha byang gi rgyal po nyi mas brgyan pa zhes bya ba: rab tu zab pa rnams kyi man ngag mi 'gyur ba'i don du: mkhas pa chen po bi ma la mi tras lho phyogs bhe ta'i yul rin po che snang bar mdzad pa rdzogs so: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya:sdi/bya: 8/bhe:

༄༅: chogag tshad nges pa'i kha byang sgron ma rang ba/rngaṭaku5 bsdo/ba/rbasdo:tshad ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes chen po de:gnyis med dbang po'i yul du rtogs bya'i phyir: rang snang bcar la 'bebs pa'i thabs dag ni: bla ma'i byin rlabs sngon gyi skal ba dang : rang gi dad pa mos gus byas pa la: brten nas gnyis med rang snang bde ba che: dbang po rnams kyi dwangs ma gang yin la: brten nas rdo rje lu gu rgyud de nyid: mngon sum gsal bar gtan la dbab pa'i phyir: gzhan du bstan pa med pa'i yi ge nyid:rnam bzhi kha byang rnams su ma bkod pa'i: gsang chen snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa la: yi ge'i 'brel po shog bu'i grangs nyid ni: 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir na 'di dag nyid: bla ma'i gdams pa snying po'i rgyud rnams la: brten nas 'khrul pa med pa'i blo gros kyis: rang bzhin rdzogs chen rnams kyi bcud phyungs pa: gsang ba'i man ngag bzhi yi rgyan 'di bkod:yang gsang dril ba'i man ngag 'di dag la: snying thig gsang ba nges pa'i gnad dang bstun: mngon sum nyid de rgyab nas 'byung ba min: snying po nges pa'i rang bzhin 'di lta bu: phyis kyang 'byung bar shin tu dkon pa 'o: de yi don gyi tshad ni 'di lta bu: gzhan gyis bsgyur cing gzhig par dka' ba'i phyir: shog tshad snod kyi bye brag 'di lta ste: rin chen lnga yi rang byung byang bu ni: sus kyang —42
